newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's parliament swears in new ministers.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's parliament swears in new ministers.

text.p: Hungary's parliament on Monday approved Prime Minister Gyula Horn's appointments for two vacant ministerial posts.

Mihaly Kokeny and Frigyes Nagy, both nominations of the Horn's Socialist Party, senior partner in the governing coalition, were sworn in as health and welfare minister and agriculture minister respectively.
Kokeny replaces Gyorgy Szabo, who resigned over what he described as insufficient health funding in the draft 1997 budget.
Nagy follows Laszlo Lakos, who was sacked by Horn after complaints from farmers that he had failed to set food subsidies for 1997 by the required November deadline.
